title: Russian Pecorino Tart
description: A classic Russian dessert with a twist of Italian pecorino cheese, all wrapped up in a flaky tart crust.
instructions: Roll out the tart crust and place in a tart pan.
In a bowl, mix together the crumbled pecorino cheese and sugar.
Pour the cheese mixture into the tart crust.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs and melted butter.
Pour the egg mixture over the cheese mixture in the tart crust.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the tart is golden brown and set.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
